name: Tinker: racial abilities work while Build: Mechsuit is active (#13657)
contract: Report #13657: while in Build: Mechsuit (801384/803451), an Orc Tinker cannot use Blood Fury (814285) or other
racial abilities. The Mechsuit applies SPELL_AURA_MOUNTED through 803451 and FORM_TINKER_MECHSUIT (49, with
SHAPESHIFT_FLAG_STANCE set), and Spell::CheckCast only exempted SpellFamilyName 34 abilities and consumable
items from SPELL_FAILED_NOT_MOUNTED (64). Racial spells belong to the racial skill lines (including CoA skill
lines 11125 and 11760) and lack SPELL_ATTR0_ALLOW_WHILE_MOUNTED, so every active combat racial failed with
SPELL_FAILED_NOT_MOUNTED. Expected: an Orc Tinker (Blood Fury 814285, skill 125), Troll Tinker (Berserking
26297, skill 733), and Draenei Tinker (Gift of the Naaru 814282, CoA skill 11760 with NOT_SHAPESHIFTED) cast
their racials cleanly inside Build: Mechsuit and remain in the suit. Control: an Orc Tinker on an ordinary mount
(Black Wolf 578) is still refused Blood Fury with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_MOUNTED (64).
